region: Andhra Pradesh coast (Godavari delta and nearby)
note: Plain-text seasonal lines for the quiet-period (watch) state and the season check for baselines (findings confidence). General climate background, not a forecast. To be checked against IMD before publishing. List order is the cyclic order of the year (used for 'adjacent').

seasons.label: early cyclone season
seasons.line: April and May can bring early cyclones to the Bay of Bengal. They are less common than in the autumn.

seasons.label: monsoon
seasons.line: June to September is the main monsoon. Heavy rain and river floods in the Godavari are most likely now.

seasons.label: post-monsoon cyclone season
seasons.line: October to December is the main cyclone season on this coast. Storms from the Bay of Bengal are most likely now.

seasons.label: dry season
seasons.line: January to March is usually dry and calm. Floods and cyclones are rare.
